## BELL'S PALSY

Herpes simplex and varicella-zoster are possible causes of Bell's palsy. Others
include Borrelia burgdorferi or trauma. Some cases are idiopathic. Risk factors
Bell's Palsy include pregnancy, diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and upper
respiratory infections. Neurology consult is encouraged.
If Lyme disease is suspected, refer to the Lyme disease treatment page:
Lyme Disease
Treatment with prednisone and an antiviral within 72 hours of symptoms onset
improves the chances of a complete recovery.
